companyFieldUpdates.description: Red de Carreteras de Occidente, S.A.P.I. de C.V. operates the Red Vía Corta toll-road platform in western and central Mexico. Its current portfolio comprises the FARAC I, COTESA and AUTOVIM concessions across Jalisco, Michoacán, Guanajuato, Aguascalientes and Nayarit; CONIPSA and COVIQSA expired in 2025 and 2026. The filed active centerline network is approximately 844.3 kilometers after those expiries. Current economic ownership is Abertis at 53.12%, GIC at approximately 29.04% within the BBVA México trust block and multiple Mexican AFORES at 17.84% through the HSBC México trust block. ICA and Goldman Sachs Infrastructure Partners are former owners. Trustee substitutions and Mundys' indirect interest through Abertis are not separate economic ownership changes, and no later sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
